subject: Request: approve pilot pricing uplift & retention waiver — Zephyr Health
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Zephyr pilot — ask for one-time uplift / retention waiver (SOW attached)

Hi team,

Quick one — Zephyr (Amy Lang) is ready to sign a 6-month Spring Pilot but their procurement pushed back on the standard minimums and our discount guardrails. They want an increased initial discount (currently requesting 40% off list for first 6 months) and a commitment that we won’t change pricing for 12 months after pilot converts.

Why this matters: Zephyr is a strategic prospect for our health vertical — high expansion potential (model inference across multiple lines), and the pilot shows volume characteristics that compress unit costs quickly. If we lock a short-term deeper discount with a prepay clause (invoice up front for pilot), we can protect long-term economics and make this a reference account.

Ask: seeking VP/CFO one-time approval to allow up to 40% pilot discount (our guardrail is 30%) tied to:
- prepayment for the 6-month pilot (net-30 invoice on sign, non-refundable for pilot)
- explicit conversion cadence: 60 days before pilot end we will present production pricing (no automatic renewal)
- retention protection clause (no unilateral price increases for 12 months post-conversion)

Attachments: Zephyr_SpringPilot_SOW.pdf, pricing-model-breakdown.xlsx (included margin calc and ARR impact).

Akira note: estimate ARR uplift if converted: ~$450k ARR incremental in year 1; expected blended gross margin after GPU cost and infra ~48% at projected usage. See spreadsheet.

Can you review and advise if we can approve this one-off waiver? If so, we’ll ask legal to prepare the amendment and get DocuSign queued.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/evelynhart

Subject: Re: Zephyr pilot — ask for one-time uplift / retention waiver (SOW attached)

Marissa / Evelyn — reviewed the spreadsheet and scenarios. I have two thoughts and a conditional approval.

Summary of ask: Approve one-time deviation for pilot pricing to allow up to 40% discount for a 6-month pilot with a 12-month post-conversion price protection clause. Pilot to be pre-paid.

Finance view:
- At 40% discount, the fast-usage scenario yields acceptable gross margin (~42%) given anticipated utilization and the prepay reduces credit risk.
- The slow-usage scenario pushes margin towards 28–30% which is below our comfort zone unless we secure the prepayment and guarantee conversion discussions at 60 days.

Conditional approval (my sign-off):
1) Prepayment required for the full 6-month pilot, non-refundable. Zephyr must sign SOW and pay within 10 business days.
2) Add a conversion review trigger at day 120 (60 days before end) with a confirmed exec sponsor from Zephyr — if no decision, auto-terminate the pilot (no refunds).
3) Approve up to 40% discount for the pilot only; require a minimum conversion floor at no less than 70% of list price for production (subject to normal negotiation).
4) Require Sales Ops to add an escrow-style consumption threshold: if usage in months 1–3 is <50% of forecast, sales must present remediation plan before continuing.

Please prepare the short legal amendment and get DocuSign link ready. Karthik — please thumb through the SOW for any pricing/usage definitions that might expose us to open-ended discounts or extended credits.

Markus
Markus Klein

Markus — thanks for the clarity. I reviewed the SOW and captured three tweaks I think Legal should include:
- define "pilot usage" explicitly (list of routes/models + max tokens/day) to avoid open-ended billing;
- limit credits/rollovers during pilot (no episodic carryover beyond the 6-month term);
- include a short clause that any production pricing below 70% of list requires exec escalation to VP Sales + CFO.

I’ll coordinate with Legal and Sales Ops to draft the amendment. Evelyn — once the amendment is ready I’ll add the DocuSign link to the HubSpot deal and we’ll request prepayment.

—Karthik

Amy — good news: finance has provided conditional approval for the 40% pilot discount under the terms we discussed. The high-level conditions are below — full amendment and DocuSign will be sent today.

Conditions (summary):
- 6-month pilot, prepay required (invoice due within 10 business days of signing) — non-refundable for pilot period.
- Pilot discount capped at 40% for the pilot term only.
- Conversion review scheduled at day 120 (60 days prior to end) with Zephyr exec sponsor to confirm production pricing.
- If usage in months 1–3 is <50% of forecast, we will pause and require a remediation plan.
- Production pricing floor targeted at >=70% of list — this is our expectation, not automatic.

Next steps: I’ll send DocuSign (amendment + SOW) after Legal adds the definitions Karthik requested. Please review quickly so we can get the prepay in this quarter.

Thanks — excited to get Zephyr across the line.
Evelyn
